'''DSS-0956''' was the [[Senior officer/Legends|senior officer]] of [[Alvien Squadron]], one of the three [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|desert stormtrooper]] squads making up the unit [[Desert Sands]].

==History==
===Joining the Stormtrooper Corps===
At some point prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], DSS-0956 joined the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] and became a desert stormtrooper. He rose to the rank of [[Senior officer/Legends|senior officer]] and was assigned to one of the three squadrons of the unit Desert Sands, Alvien Squadron.<ref name="TD" /> While in Desert Sands, he served under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Nahdonnis Praji]].<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

===Looking for the Death Star plans===
[[File:Mos_Eisley_Stormtroopers.jpg|thumb|left|300px|DSS-0956 served on Tatooine as a sandtrooper when searching for the Death Star plans.]]
In 0 BBY, DSS-0956 was on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Inquisitor (Star Destroyer)|Inquisitor]]'' doing training exercises with Desert Sands.<ref name="Hyperspace">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref> The unit was soon deployed to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to search for two droids carrying [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="TD" /> While looking for the droids, DSS-0956 reported to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mod Terrik]] of [[Zeta Squadron (Desert Sands)|Zeta Squadron]], one of the other two squads.<ref name="CSWE DSS-0956" /> The droids were found to have been sold to the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], to which Alvien and Zeta Squadrons were sent to check. Upon being spat on by [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], Terrik ordered Lars and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|his wife]] be killed and their homestead destroyed, which was carried out under the command of DSS-0956.<ref name="TD" />

Eventually, Alvien Squadron was sent to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] to supplement the local garrison. They set up checkpoints at entrances to the city to potentially catch the droids if they tried to enter. DSS-0956 was in charge of one such checkpoint. At one point, he stopped someone and asked to see their identification.<ref name="TD" />

==Equipment==
DSS-0956 was equipped with the standard modified [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] issued to sandtroopers. He also carried a long-range [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], a heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], and a food/water [[Backpack/Legends|pack]].<ref name="TD" />

==Behind the scenes==
DSS-0956 was created in [[1989]]'s ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'', and was featured in the ''[[Tatooine Debriefing]]'' story within the book.<ref name="TD" />

===Inconsistencies===
In the [[2007]] [https://www.rebelscum.com/SSCDIOdroids.asp "Look Sir, Droids" action figure set] made by [[Sideshow Collectibles]], DSS-0956 was identified as the sandtrooper who was addressed by [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth]] in<ref name="Sideshow">{{SideshowCite|set=Polystone Dioramas|pack=Look Sir, Droids|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/SSCDIOdroids.asp}}</ref> the source scene from the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Episode IV" /> However, the [[1996]] story ''[[When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale]]'' identified that character as Mod Terrik, who was further established to be killed attempting to prevent the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} escape,<ref name="Stormtrooper">{{StoryCite|story=When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> whereas DSS-0956 was established by ''Tatooine Debriefing'' to have lived past those events.<ref name="TD" /> In [[2008]], DSS-0956 was given an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which clarified that he served under Terrik.<ref name="CSWE DSS-0956" />
